# Thaba Ya Metsi Private Game Reserve

> A 132-hectare private game reserve on the southern edge of the Waterberg, between Mookgopong and Mokopane, Limpopo, South Africa. Sepedi name meaning "water mountain". Under private ownership.

Key facts: 250 km north of Johannesburg; 1 hour south of Polokwane; malaria-free; not a Big 5 reserve; free-roaming kudu, bushbuck, klipspringer, mountain reedbuck, leopard, brown hyena; a 50-hectare sable antelope breeding camp; a private Boran cattle genetics programme (IVF, embryo transfer, genomic selection); one farm hotel on the reserve, The Maravi (8 rooms), booked at https://www.themaravi.com/. The reserve is not open to day visitors.

- [Conservation](https://www.thabayametsi.com/conservation): water, fire, fences, commitments
- [Stay](https://www.thabayametsi.com/stay): The Maravi, the reserve's farm hotel
- [Journal](https://www.thabayametsi.com/journal): dated notes from the reserve
- [The Name](https://www.thabayametsi.com/the-name): meaning and pronunciation
- [Visit and Contact](https://www.thabayametsi.com/visit): directions, GPS, access
